scope: future detached interface only; no wiring, authority, persistence, or sound

hearth_channel_unchanged.rule: purchase proof is not accepted as gate input; receipt is only a publisher-side gate eligibility predicate

consumer.guard: registered local publisher in same live scene only; never import playback stream, storage state, or replay/test transcript; epoch seed arms identity but never plays
consumer.strict_order: per scene, non-reused publication_order, producer-serialized after physics; if order is stale, duplicate, or discontinuous then drop and disarm, never buffer/replay
consumer.success: one immutable SFX intent keyed level1.gate.close.settled plus gate ID, identity key and ordering; intent is not an audio receipt or instruction to mutate game
suppressed: paid hearth event on distinct channel
mute or disabled bus; consume once and never replay when unmuted

required_before_use: separately reviewed compatible owned SFX consumer with gate cue allowlist
separate approved sound and device proof
